scope: Independent full-source critical review; no crawler instantiated and no network/browser/CMS/GitHub action.

checks.network: Only normalized HTTPS arvisclinic.ru; no inherited proxy, cookie jar or authentication handler; TLS defaults remain enabled.
checks.rate: One shared sequential 0.51-second start gate for every request including assets/redirect hops; persisted timestamp on resume; exclusive process lock.
checks.redirects: Manual bounded same-host HTTPS redirects; forbidden paths and loops stop before following.
checks.raw_payloads: Response bytes saved unchanged; parsing is discovery-only, no HTML/link/CSS rewrites.
checks.discovery: Nested sitemaps, ordinary links, srcset, stylesheets, CSS url/import and inline style resources; resources retain paths with documented URL-qualified query/page mapping.
checks.boundaries: Video/audio/PDF downloads and private/core/config/log/backup paths excluded; no private project inputs read.
checks.privacy: Cookie/Auth/Token/API/CSRF-like headers redacted; metadata URL userinfo and sensitive query values removed; detected high-confidence secret bodies are not persisted.
checks.resume_and_coverage: Valid cached payload hashes checked; failed no-body records do not auto-retry; explicit retry flag; budgets/parse failures/pending queue remain visible; no universal coverage claim.

validation.offline_assertions: PASS: URL/query order, host/userinfo/path rejection, private/PDF/video paths, allowed static vendor resource, metadata/header redaction, CSS import/url

limitations: Source review establishes intended request pacing, not empirical runtime timing.
Regex/HTMLParser discovery is bounded; client-generated JavaScript links are outside HTTP-only discovery.
Artifact byte/hash/path and secret checks must run on the completed dedicated audit folder before GitHub packaging.
The initial Playwright lookup missed a bundled runtime; parent later verified preinstalled 1.62.1. Final screenshot status and counts belong to the capture runner report.
